append.detail: Closed 2026-11-16 for the readiness review only. docs/hunts/EXPANSION-REVIEW.md reads the tree and gives, for teams, branches and Mystery, gifts and sponsor milestones, seasonal editions, the collective and partner model and paid passes: what is built, the switch that gates it, the approvals still owed and by whom, the monitoring that exists and the rollback. Not done and not claimed: the comparison of cohorts, operational cost, merchant benefit and field risks. There is no pilot data: every Hunts switch is off in production, no cohort has run, and the page states no figure. That comparison, the choice of expansions and the production run of the legacy inventory moved to FH-048S. Finding: no expansion has its own switch. Teams and branches share HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED with every solo claim, editions and the partner pages share HUNTS_AUTHORING_ENABLED, and gifts, sponsor milestones and paid passes share HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; no Hunt event carries a team, branch, edition, gift or sponsor dimension. So the Done-when bar of an own flag and own monitoring per chosen expansion is NOT met; it moved to FH-048T. Also recorded: with HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED off the Hunt side of refunds and the gift mirror stop, so the safe stop for money features is the sales pause first. Legacy retirement: the page inventories the Regulars, QR campaign and capped-code paths that still ship and the obligations on them, gives read-only SQL to measure active use and unredeemed rewards, and says retirement is not recommended or scheduled until that SQL is run on production. No database, switch value or log was read.
